Focus now: Adding a daily challenge mode to the Lantern Run mobile game
Pieces of work:
- Daily challenge (also called the daily run): being worked on now. Each day's level is generated from a seed all players share; the generator works and its difficulty is not tuned yet. Plan changed; it was a fixed set of hand-built levels, one for each day. Changed at this step.
- Challenge leaderboard: not started yet. A board of each day's challenge scores; nothing is built yet.
- Streak rewards: not started yet. Rewards for playing the challenge many days in a row; nothing is built yet.
